# alex markin

> official website of alex markin, also known as alexander markin: a student, artist, specialty coffee barista, and occasional software producer based bw copenhagen and berlin. they work on art projects, documentary photography, writing, video editing, and open creative software — but are up for anything

## primary page

- [official profile](https://alex-markin.com/): biography, contact information, social profiles, publications, creative projects, and latest photography

## selected work

- [coffee recipes](https://alex-markin.com/coffee): working recipes kept by alex as a specialty coffee barista at darcy's kaffe in copenhagen
- [webdesign trials](https://alex-markin.com/trials/): studies in texture, motion, display, and pointer effects
- [louppe app](https://louppe.eu/): free, open-source, keyboard-first photo and video culler for macOS
- [new york times summer reading contest winner](https://www.nytimes.com/2025/06/24/learning/the-authoritarian-playbook-is-always-the-same-the-week-1-winner-of-our-summer-reading-contest.html): “the authoritarian playbook is always the same”
- [podcast on russian colonialism](https://youtu.be/SKE0fzSEpo8): video editing for radio echo
- [without feeling the country beneath us](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pyVTY9q6JZA): documentary on the first gulag
